scores.label: A
scores.note: Only option 1 'serious' fits ('something serious happens'). Options 2-10 are 0: they are noun phrases with articles ('something an emergency happens') and are ungrammatical when they replace only 'bad'. Option 8 'a trouble' is also unidiomatic.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Options 1 'happens' and 2 'occurs' are 0. They are verbs that replace 'happens', not 'bad', and give 'something happens happens'. The rest are duplicates.
